body:
As of pr #911, we worked with @CarlosAllendes in the following adjustments to finally finish in a complete revision of version 4.0.3.

not to start from scratch and preserve the valuable work that was done. The starting point was the pr #911 through "Cherry Pick".

It was translated up to version 4.0.3 and the following revisions were made.

- Spanish language conventions
- Revised against Latin American conventions
- Proper use of anglicisms
- latin voice overs
- and some translations that its literal form sounds bad in Spanish.

Although everything is perfectible, we did the best we could trying to maintain the integrity of the idea to be transmitted.

Thanks

comments.body:
Hi, thank you for translation!

Please give us some time to implement clear process for getting translation into ASVS. 
It includes some git branching instructions, markdown format validation etc.
@hansphp - do you have experience and knowledge, who is using ASVS translations? I would like to be sure, that proposed new process fits their actual needs.
Of course, @CarlosAllendes and I used the translation to train some development teams about the S-SDLC in Chile and Mexico.

i just deleted the binary file "4.0/OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 4.0.2-es.pdf" that was filtered with the changes but was not generated with the process or with the md files corresponding to 4.0.3.

Everything else is correct
